fast_movement.name: Fast Movement
fast_movement.description: +10 ft to base land speed when wearing no armor, light armor, or medium armor and not carrying a heavy load.

illiteracy.name: Illiteracy
illiteracy.description: Cannot read or write unless 2 skill points are spent or a level in another class is gained.

rage_1.name: Rage
rage_1.description: +4 STR, +4 CON, +2 morale bonus on Will saves, -2 AC penalty while raging.

uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
uncanny_dodge.description: Retains Dexterity bonus to AC even if caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.

improved_uncanny_dodge.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
improved_uncanny_dodge.description: Cannot be flanked except by a rogue of at least 4 levels higher.

greater_rage.name: Greater Rage
greater_rage.description: Rage bonuses increase to +6 STR, +6 CON, and +3 morale bonus on Will saves.

indomitable_will.name: Indomitable Will
indomitable_will.description: +4 bonus on Will saves to resist enchantment spells while in a rage.

tireless_rage.name: Tireless Rage
tireless_rage.description: No longer becomes fatigued at the end of a rage.

mighty_rage.name: Mighty Rage
mighty_rage.description: Rage bonuses increase to +8 STR, +8 CON, and +4 morale bonus on Will saves.

acfSwaps.name: Whirling Frenzy
acfSwaps.description: Replaces standard Rage with Whirling Frenzy (+4 STR, +2 dodge bonus to AC and Reflex saves, and 1 extra attack at highest BAB with -2 penalty).

acfSwaps.name: Lion Spirit Totem (Pounce)
acfSwaps.description: Replaces Fast Movement with Pounce, allowing a full attack at the end of a charge.

acfSwaps.name: Wolf Totem (Improved Trip)
acfSwaps.description: Replaces Uncanny Dodge with Improved Trip as a bonus feat without needing Combat Expertise.
